knowledge:
- key_parameters: type=Specifies the model/CpG set type in extractSites(); "se" (default) uses the Lasso penalty within one standard error of the minimum (retaining fewer CpGs), while "all" retrieves all sites. ;; mlmatr=A data frame or matrix of CpG beta values (between 0 and 1) passed to predictGA().
- alternatives: None mentioned.
- when_to_use: Use when estimating gestational age from blood-based DNA methylation data generated on Illumina HumanMethylation450 arrays.
- pitfalls: The input CpG matrix must not contain NA values for the required predictor CpGs. The input CpGs must be fully compliant with the Illumina HumanMethylation450 array design.

workflows.name: gestational_age_prediction
workflows.intent: Predict gestational age from blood DNA methylation data.
input: mlmatr (A data frame or matrix of Illumina HumanMethylation450 CpG beta values between 0 and 1, with samples as rows and CpGs as columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Extract required CpG sites using extractSites ;; 2. Prepare the input matrix ensuring no NAs in required CpGs ;; 3. Predict gestational age using predictGA
workflows.code:
cpgs <- extractSites( type="se" )
allcpgs <- extractSites( type="all" )
numsamples <- 100
mlmatr <- matrix( NA, ncol=length( allcpgs ), nrow=numsamples )
mlmatr <- data.frame( mlmatr )
for( i in cpgs )
  mlmatr[,i] <- runif( numsamples, min=0, max=1 )
mypred <- predictGA( mlmatr )
head( mypred )
